coverage.selection: All API-visible rows with createdAt strictly before T; no state or template filter.
coverage.stateSemantics: States and mutable fields are observed at read time, not reconstructed at T.

nullPolicy.apiNull: The API explicitly returned null; it supplied no further value or cause.
nullPolicy.omitted: The API did not supply this field; no value is inferred.
nullPolicy.unavailable: The endpoint or parent object was unavailable; see errors.

coverage.countMeaning: API count is this page's size, never the overall total.
coverage.pagination: before = oldest createdAt on the preceding page + 1 millisecond; deduplicate by id
coverage.sortedIdsEncoding: sha256(UTF-8 of lexicographically sorted IDs joined with LF; no trailing LF)
